title: University of Hyderabad students protest against faculty member

tea.why: Students are protesting against a History faculty member accused of using casteist, classist, and Islamophobic language in emails.
tea.want: The protesters are demanding the termination of the faculty member.
tea.changed: Nov 22: The protest entered its third day as the Students' Union continued their sit-in at the School of Social Sciences.

summary: Students at the University of Hyderabad, led by the Students' Union, have been holding an indefinite sit-in protest for three consecutive days. The demonstration, located in front of the School of Social Sciences, follows allegations that a History faculty member, Dr. Vijaya Ramadas Mandala, used discriminatory language in emails sent in April 2026. According to the Students' Union, these communications contained casteist slurs against Dalit students, derogatory remarks about students from Bihar and Jharkhand, and Islamophobic comments. The union also alleges that the faculty member intimidated students associated with progressive groups. Protesters report that the university administration, including the Vice-Chancellor and the Anti-Discrimination Cell, has remained silent regarding their demands for termination. The union has reached out to various public figures and academics to seek intervention in the matter.
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The protest entered its third day with students continuing their sit-in at the School of Social Sciences.

sources.title: UoH Students' Union continues indefinite sit-in for third day, demands termination of History Faculty
